name: X0X
intro: A groovebox with a 909, an 808, two 303s and a break player. It starts with empty patterns, so add some steps before you press PLAY.

rows.what: Pick the part: 909, 808, 303A, 303B or BREAK.
The part's sound. Tap again for the next page.
The part's steps: length, rate and more.
Patterns and mutes for all five parts. Tap again for the song.
Previous or next page. In a list, moves up and down.
This screen as a list, including the extra settings.
Undo. Use HOME + PLAY to redo.
Start or stop.
909/808: pick a drum track (you hear it while stopped).
Turn the selected track's step on or off.
Accent that step.
Next 16 steps (up to 64). OCT- goes back.
909/808: mute or unmute that drum track.
Record drum hits and knob moves live. On a 303, the keys become a keyboard.
BREAK: play that slice yourself.
BREAK: reverse, half speed, stutter.
Change the four values shown at the bottom of the screen.
Set that knob back to its default.
303: TB-3PO writes a new line. OCT- mutates it.
303: filter cutoff (KNOB 2 sets resonance).
Mixer: PARTS, 909 MIX, 808 MIX, MASTER (tap again for next).
Reverb and delay. Tap again for the next page.
On EDIT: that step gets its own value (p-lock).
The chance that step plays.
On HOME: pick a pattern for all five parts (at bar end).
Pick a pattern from any screen.
Next pattern: this part only, or all five on HOME.
On HOME: mute or unmute a whole part.
Set the tempo.
Copy the current pattern onto that one.
Clear the selected part in this pattern (asks first).
Song: put that pattern in the next bar.
Save everything. While playing, it saves when you stop.
Delete that knob's recorded motion.
Settings: autosave, clear pattern, factory reset, MIDI.
After 5 seconds: update mode. Let go early to cancel.
Calibrate the buttons and knobs.
In SAFE MODE: try starting X0X normally again.

keys.label: Drum tracks BD SD LT MT HT RS CP CH OH CR RD; HOME: mute parts 1-5

tips: Quick beat: black key 1 (kick), then white keys 1, 5, 9, 13, then PLAY.
Hold any button for a second on its own: a card explains what it does here.
With the pattern stopped, X0X autosaves 4 seconds after your last change.
The factory mix pumps hard. For a clean mix, set COMP and PUMP to 0 on LFO > MASTER.
While a pattern plays, picking a drum is silent so you don't add stray hits.
checked: Archive x0x-1.1.0.tar.gz from thefirmwarehub.com/src (catalog mirror), folder fm1-x0x-1.1.0.
Button/encoder labels: firmware/src/app/panel.c B_NAME/E_NAME, plat.h enums.
Key layout: ui.c KEY_WHITE/KEY_BLACK (16 white, 11 black, index 0 = F3).
Button taps: ui.c button_tap() (EDIT/SEQ/ARP/FX/LFO cycle pages; HOME toggles HOME/SONG; HOME+REC undo, HOME+PLAY redo; SAVE+REC clear part; SAVE+OCT copy bank; OCT on steps/HOME/TB-3PO/keyboard).

Encoders: ui.c input(): SELECT pages / list / HOME+SELECT tempo / held step = probability (prob_turn); ALGORITHM part; PRESETS part or all five; knobs: p-lock on held step, SAVE+knob forget motion, ENV+knob default.

Keys: ui.c key_event(), drum_key() (silent while playing unless KEY SOUND or REC), drum_step() (ENV+white = accent), bass_kbd(), bass_step_key(); HOME white = pattern/chain, black 1-5 = mute part; HOME+black on drum screen = mute track; SAVE+white = paste.
Break live keys: dsp/breaks.c perf_sync(): keys 0-7 slices, 8 reverse, 9 half, 10 stutter.
303 TONE page = CUTOFF, RESO, ENVMOD, DECAY: ui.c build_pages(); mixer pages PARTS, 909 MIX, 808 MIX, MASTER (DRIVE, COMP, PUMP, FILTER).
Start state: ui_init() view V_PART part 909; project.c project_defaults() + seq/pattern.c pattern_init(): all patterns empty, break steps off, 125 BPM.
Save: ui.c save_project() (SAVES WHEN STOPPED), autosave() 4000 ms quiet, stopped only.
Recovery: main_fm1.c OCT-+OCT+ 5 s update mode with countdown/cancel, OCT-+OCT+ at power-on panel_setup(), safe_main() PLAY restarts.
Help cards: ui.c help_tick()/help_lines() (hold a single button).
unsure: README says it should make noise the moment you press PLAY, but the code starts with every pattern empty (pattern_init). The sheet follows the code and the manual.
SONG screen's SEL list (LENGTH, INSERT BAR, DELETE BAR, CLEAR SONG) and song recording (REC + PLAY on SONG) are only partly checked, so they are left out.
MIDI default channels (909 ch10, 808 ch11, 303A ch2, 303B ch3, break ch4) and USB audio were not checked in code, so there is no MIDI section.
